verdict.rationale: Bolt's core interaction is delegating work to its built-in AI. The docs describe Standard and Max agents, a Plan Mode for asking questions without changing code, reusable Skills, automatic model routing, a design-system agent, and agent-driven security fixes. The GitHub repo says the AI has full control of the filesystem, terminal and server and can deploy from chat, and a hands-on user reports 99% of edits were made through prompts. Community reports of the agent making unauthorized changes and getting stuck in break/fix loops show the delegation works but is not always reliable. Missing for 10: dependable control over what the delegated agent changes (independent reports of unapproved edits and regression loops).
